findings.summary: The arms paragraph and the reviewed run's manifest record the head measure at 74858ce4f3, not at the reviewed head 7d65b53c6e: the landed head's last commit is docs-only, so the passing arm still covers the code under review, but a reader comparing the record's revision against the promoted commit sees a one-commit gap that the record does not explain.

raw_text:
VERDICT goal: the node's goal is that tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py passes in full, and the diff at 74858ce4f3 changes only that file's _Host.request (tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py:426) to send the ownership mark its host requires; the recorded head arm reads 12 passed, EXIT=0.
VERDICT done_when: the done_when asks for the named file passing in full as an all_debug job with SLURM_JOB_ID unset, a red base arm, and a per-cause verdict with no assertion weakened; base-named-file-worktree.log reads 3 failed, 9 passed, EXIT=1 and head-named-file.log reads 12 passed, EXIT=0, and the manifest carries the three-verdict cause table.
VERDICT write_paths: the reviewed run declared reckon, tests, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround and docs/figures/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/<node-id>, and both diff paths (tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py, docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-a-pane-settles-when-no-work-is-live.html) are inside them.
VERDICT manifest: read at manifest.md; it reads status complete, names 74858ce4f3 and 7d65b53c6e, records 12 passed at head against 3 failed, 9 passed at base, and attributes the archive-tree errors to a missing .git rather than to code under test.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against 1feacf337c commit by commit; 74858ce4f3 is a 7-line harness change and 7d65b53c6e adds a 76-line landing fragment, no product source changed and nothing lies outside the declared scope.
CALL_SITES: reckon/crew/session_host.py:parse_request, reckon/crew/session_host.py:_SessionHost._pair_is_owners, reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:_request_line, reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:_deliver_request
SCORE goal_fidelity: 19
JUSTIFICATION goal_fidelity: tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py:431 now sends owner_checked, which reckon/crew/session_host.py:279 is the field parse_request reads, so the file's 12 cases pass for the reason the production writer passes it.
SCORE evidence: 18
JUSTIFICATION evidence: head-named-file.log and base-named-file-worktree.log record the two arms with bare EXIT=0 and EXIT=1 lines from all_debug jobs, though both name 74858ce4f3 rather than the reviewed head 7d65b53c6e.
SCORE scope_discipline: 19
JUSTIFICATION scope_discipline: git diff 1feacf337c 7d65b53c6e touches only tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py and the node's own fragment, both inside the declared paths, with no product or plan edit.
SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: no assertion was added, and the guard is the file itself — removing owner_checked from tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py:431 reddens exactly the three cases base-named-file-worktree.log records as FAILED at the base revision.
SCORE fit: 19
JUSTIFICATION fit: tests/test_a_pane_settles_when_no_work_is_live.py:427-431 follows the marked-request idiom of tests/test_a_settled_follower_rearms_while_its_session_owns_work.py:123, `ruff check` and `ruff format --check` report no finding on the changed path, and the fragment's element ids are node-prefixed.
SCORE reuse: 20
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change adds no definition; it reuses the `owner_checked` key whose owner is reckon/crew/dispatch_watch.py:_request_line, searched across reckon/crew for a request-line writer and found there.
FINDING docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/qwnw-red-file-a-pane-settles-when-no-work-is-live.html:60 non-blocking: the arms paragraph, and the manifest it was copied from, record the head measure at 74858ce4f3 rather than the reviewed head 7d65b53c6e; the last commit is docs-only so the arm still covers the code, but the record's revision and the promoted revision differ without the record saying why.
